goal: Double users, Western users and ad revenue every week

weeks.focus: ChatGPT sends 69% of traffic but only 28.8% of sessions are Western, and Western visitors earn the high CPMs. This week: grow US/UK/CA/AU/EU players specifically, push YouTube Shorts as the one social channel that works, and fix tracking so revenue per channel is visible.

plan.title: Win Western players from AI assistants
plan.detail: Ship English pages written for US/UK search and ChatGPT prompts ('unblocked games for school', 'free horror games no download', 'games like Among Us in browser'). Use US spelling and Western references, and link them from /horror/ and llms.txt.

plan.title: Feed ChatGPT more landing pages
plan.detail: ChatGPT's top landing page is /horror/ (171 sessions). Ship one AI-friendly page a day (best-of lists, 'games like X' guides) for the categories ChatGPT already links to: horror, escape, cooking, Among Us-style, Brawl Stars-style. Keep llms.txt and the sitemap updated.

plan.title: Post Shorts at US prime time
plan.detail: Schedule YouTube Shorts for 7–10 PM US Eastern (5:30–8:30 AM IST) with English titles and #shorts #gaming tags. Facebook and Instagram already send 100% Western traffic (18 + 7 sessions): repost the same Shorts there as Reels.

plan.title: YouTube Shorts only: 3 a day
plan.detail: YouTube brought 48 of 60 post-attributed sessions; X and Reddit brought 0. Make Shorts of The House 2, Getting Over It, Protect My Dog, Books Tower and Escape From Work. Pause X and cut Facebook/Instagram to reposts of the same Shorts.

plan.title: Mark GA4 key events
plan.detail: GA4 > Admin > Events: mark fullscreen_click (and any game_start event) as key events. Until then conversions read 0 and we can't tell which traffic is worth anything.

plan.title: Log every post with its UTM
plan.detail: 118 UTM sessions have no matching post (e.g. YouTube compilation-1). Unlogged posts mean we can't double down on what works.

plan.title: Make horror the front door
plan.detail: Horror games dominate (The House 2, Backrooms, Scary Doll, Poppy Playtime, FNAF). Strengthen /horror/ with a curated top-10, internal links to guides, and 'play next' links between horror games to lift pages per visit and return visits (D1 retention is 12%).

plan.title: Check Adsterra geo and formats
plan.detail: CPM is $0.52 across all traffic. In Adsterra, check CPM by country and turn on the higher-paying formats (Social Bar, in-page push) for Western geos only, so non-Western visitors don't get a heavier ad load.

days.summary: Traffic nearly tripled week on week, but 69% comes from ChatGPT alone. Search and most social are near zero, retention is weak and ad earnings are tiny.
wins: Sessions +195%, pageviews +281% vs the previous 7 days
ChatGPT now recommends the site: 809 sessions, mostly to /horror/
problems: Western share only 28.8% (317 of 1,164 sessions); India is the top country
Adsterra about $0.70 for the week at $0.52 CPM
Conversions read 0: no GA4 key events
learnings: AI assistants are the fastest-growing channel for a games site; pages ChatGPT can cite (clear categories, lists) get the clicks
YouTube Shorts is the only social channel that sends players
